description: This file defines an Angular module named LoginModule, which imports necessary Angular core modules, Angular Material UI components, and sets up routing for the login component. It also provides a configuration for LOGIN_API_BASE, attempting to retrieve a URL from the global window object, with a fallback to localhost.

classes.name: LoginModule
classes.description: An Angular module that encapsulates the login functionality, declaring and exporting LoginComponent, and providing configuration for API base URL.

methods.name: provide: LOGIN_API_BASE
methods.description: Factory provider that attempts to retrieve the API base URL from the global window object, with a fallback to 'http://localhost:3001'.
